verdict.rationale: Convex's first-party docs describe native vector search that finds Convex documents similar to a provided vector. They state these vectors are typically embeddings of text, images, or audio, used to give LLMs context and power recommendations. Embeddings are therefore stored in Convex documents and searched natively, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: details on defining vector indexes (dimensions, filter fields, limits), explicit documentation of the embedding storage schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search.
